display_name: Phase1 冻结基座特征条件半监督恢复网络
description: 冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 和原 DURA，以基座特征条件化受限 IQ 校正；源训练使用合法 L_s 标签和高置信 U_s clean 伪目标。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发不同于另一个对话的星地恢复网络；只看 Phase1 地面训练测试集；地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；每个星地视图相对同一冻结基座 clean 损失不超过 3 个百分点。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s source paired received and clean IQ, F feature-conditioned frozen DURA anchor
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: 6300 legal L_s labels only; U_s uses confident F(clean) pseudo-labels; no U_s labels, V or test IQ
data.augmentation: Source 20 views then repeat first 10; random order with 25% clean identity

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s labels and L_s/U_s source IQ, frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no U_s labels/V/test during training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record prediction using received IQ and frozen F/DURA only
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed single-seed Phase1 development test, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Original frozen DURA E20, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50, new zero-output conditioned Transformer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original 7/63/30 source-only metadata and pinned release; F exact original checkpoint ancestry and matching L_s/U_s IDs; DURA SHA bound into field checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both inherited Phase1 models are source-only and frozen; generation field from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E30, no target-dependent model selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU true F/G L_s smoke; shared lock, at most two same-user restoration workers and two same-user compute processes/card, >=12000 MB; legacy capacity marker; persistent GPU B128 smoke then fresh E30 and prediction
execution.stop_rule: Source ID/label/IQ mismatch, smoke failure, nonfinite gradient, resource ambiguity, frozen weight change or incomplete predictions preserves artifacts; no automatic retry or performance-based stop

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 在合法 L_s 源训练集，clean 教师与 DURA 判断不一致时，clean 教师分别符合源标签 262/270 和 278/286；此结果不证明 U_s 或测试域同样可靠。
以真实物理 ID 将合法 6300 条 L_s 标签映射到原始 63000 条源训练记录；核验 F 源 IQ 底层索引和 clean IQ。U_s 标签一律不可读、内部一律 -1；仅 F(clean) 置信度≥0.95 时使用 U_s 伪目标。
输入接收 IQ、DURA IQ 以及冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME 对 DURA IQ 的 160 维特征和六类概率，经过单次 Transformer 输出校正；每条校正 L2 限制为 DURA 输出 L2 的 10%。此上限不保证物理保真或测试提升。
损失为 0.05×有效目标的分类边界 softplus（基座错误样本权重 8、边界 0.5）+0.1×源 IQ NMSE+0.01×正确或无伪目标样本相对于 DURA 基座输出的 KL 保持。L_s 真标签优先于 clean 伪目标。
CPU 实际权重两条 L_s 和 GPU B128 L_s smoke 后临时学生权重丢弃，正式训练重新初始化。源档案在 smoke 中物化 512 条 native IQ（L128/U384），源标签表物化 6300 条合法 L_s 标签。
F 和 DURA 全程冻结；不访问 U_s 标签、V 或测试 IQ 训练。固定 E30/14790，20 个源视图后重复前 10，25% clean 身份样本；七视图全部预测固定后才连接真值。
候选设计前 Phase1 开发测试已被观察，后续同集非独立盲测；分类器敏感扰动可能影响物理保真，应同时报告真实测试表现，不能用源训练损失宣称达标。

rows.method: Frozen F feature-conditioned bounded Transformer with L_s supervised and U_s confidence-filtered source targets
rows.purpose: Learn correction using frozen identity features and legitimate source labels while preserving strong anchor decisions
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: E30 x63000, batch128, 14790 updates; 6300 legal L_s labels each epoch; U_s pseudo confidence 0.95; correction radius 10%; 25% clean identity
